items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates; allow only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries; continue existing read-only evidence work; do not access credentials, change permissions, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Retain the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work or production changes.
